newsitem.title: MEXICO: Hungary's President Goncz to visit Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's President Goncz to visit Mexico.

text.p: Hungarian President Arpad Goncz is expected to arrive in Mexico next week for a two-day state visit, the Foreign Ministry said on Saturday.
Goncz will be in Mexico on Monday and on Tuesday as part of a wider Latin American tour, including visits to Argentina, Brazil and Paraguay.
The Hungarian leader will meet President Ernesto Zedillo to talk about bilateral and international topics of "mutual interest", the ministry said.
Goncz was in Buenos Aires earlier this week where he met with President Carlos Menem of Argentina before travelling on to neighbouring Paraguay.
